issues.detail: The Hebrew 'וְחִלֵּלוּ' (from חלל, 'to profane/defile') is rendered as 'sẽ được ăn như thường lệ' ('will eat as usual'), which is a substantive mistranslation. The Hebrew verb means 'they will profane/defile' (the vineyards), not 'eat as usual.' This changes the meaning of the verse.
